$comment: The single list of settings every integration exposes. Tests check that each integration (GitHub Action, Azure DevOps task, GitLab component, CircleCI orb, Jenkins step) offers every one of these, with the same default, and that docs/settings.md lists them.

settings.name: configuration-path
settings.description: Directory that holds the Datum configuration (the folder containing Datum.yml), relative to the working directory. Set this or configuration-repository-url, not both.

settings.name: configuration-repository-url
settings.description: HTTPS or SSH URL of a Git repository that holds the Datum configuration. The runner clones it. Set this or configuration-path, not both. Requires git on the agent.

settings.name: configuration-revision
settings.description: Branch, tag or commit to check out when configuration-repository-url is set. A full 40-character commit SHA is verified after the clone and is the recommended value.

settings.name: source-token
settings.description: Token used to clone configuration-repository-url over HTTPS when the repository is private. Needs read access to that repository only. Supply it from the platform's secret store.

settings.name: mode
settings.description: Test reports drift and changes nothing. Set applies the configuration. DryRun validates the configuration without calling an engine, connecting to a target or reading a credential.

settings.name: engine
settings.description: DscV2 uses Invoke-DscResource (PowerShell resources; most are Windows-only). DscV3 uses the dsc command-line engine, which must already be installed and on PATH.

settings.name: engine-version
settings.description: Optional engine version passed to the runner (-EngineVersion). Leave empty for the engine's default.

settings.name: fail-on-error
settings.description: Fail the step when the run status is Failed or Aborted. In Test mode drift counts as a failure, so this makes a Test run a compliance gate.

settings.name: report-path
settings.description: Directory for the reports (CSV and JSON per node, report.json, and this integration's result.json and outputs.env). Created if missing. Publish it as a build artifact.

settings.name: connect
settings.description: AzureDevOps opens an Azure DevOps session before the run, for configurations that manage Azure DevOps with AzureDevOpsDscNative. That module must be installed (list it in resource-modules).

settings.name: azure-devops-organization
settings.description: Azure DevOps organization name. Required when connect is AzureDevOps.

settings.name: azure-devops-authentication
settings.description: How to authenticate to Azure DevOps. PAT needs azure-devops-token. ManagedIdentity needs an agent that runs with an Azure managed identity.

settings.name: azure-devops-token
settings.description: Azure DevOps personal access token (20 to 120 letters and digits). Required when connect is AzureDevOps, authentication is PAT and mode is not DryRun. Supply it from the platform's secret store.

settings.name: module-version
settings.description: Exact Dsc.PipelineRunner version to install, for example 1.2.1. Pinning is recommended. Empty uses a version already on the agent, otherwise installs the newest stable release.

settings.name: allow-prerelease
settings.description: Allow a preview version of Dsc.PipelineRunner (needed when module-version names one, for example 1.3.0-preview1).

settings.name: module-repository
settings.description: Registered PowerShell repository to install modules from. Use this for an internal feed; the repository must already be registered on the agent.

settings.name: module-source
settings.description: Where Dsc.PipelineRunner comes from. Gallery installs a published release (module-version, module-repository). Repository clones the module's source repository at module-source-ref, builds it on the agent and runs that build; use it to run an unreleased commit, a branch or a fork. Requires git.

settings.name: module-source-repository
settings.description: Git URL of the Dsc.PipelineRunner source repository, used when module-source is Repository. Point it at a fork or an internal mirror if you need to. Its build script runs on the agent, so use only a repository you trust.

settings.name: module-source-ref
settings.description: Tag, branch or commit of the source repository to build. Required when module-source is Repository. A full 40-character commit SHA is verified after the clone and is the recommended value.

settings.name: resource-modules
settings.description: DSC resource modules the configuration uses, one per line or comma-separated, as Name or Name@Version (for example PSDscResources@2.12.0.0). Pinning versions is recommended.

settings.name: skip-module-install
settings.description: Install nothing. Use on agents or container images where Dsc.PipelineRunner and the resource modules are already present, or where the agent has no access to a module repository.

settings.name: keep-temporary-directory
settings.description: Keep the clone and the compiled per-node YAML on disk after the run, to debug a compile failure.

settings.name: verbose
settings.description: Write the runner's verbose log.

outputs.name: status
outputs.description: Overall run status: Completed, PartialSuccess, Failed or Aborted; or InvalidSettings when the settings were not valid and nothing ran.

outputs.name: fail-count
outputs.description: Number of resources that failed (in Test mode this includes drift).

outputs.name: report-path
outputs.description: Absolute path of the report directory.
